description: The uninstall disable pass's post hooks with its change context: a .py hook runs through the wrapper, a row whose file is missing is skipped, and the console gets the same text as the main log.
departure: Today pfb_logger() stamps each line it starts on the console with the date and time, as in the main log; the one-shot copies the main log unstamped.

expect.log:
[ pfB Hook ] post Reload (hook_post_a.py, timeout 60s)
reloaded
[ pfB Hook ] post Reload completed
[ pfB Hook ] post #1 script 'hook_post_missing.sh' not a valid file in {root}/hooks; skipping

[ pfB Hook ] post #2 (hook_post_c.sh, timeout 60s)
done
[ pfB Hook ] post #2 completed
